name: Bruce Carries Sam Down the Stairs
description: Bruce runs down the stairs carrying Sam, who is trickling.
related_events: Bruce carries Sam down the stairs

name: Grace Offers a Prayer of Thanks
description: Grace bows her head and speaks softly, thanking God. Her voice carries a tone of relief and appreciation, directed upward as if in communion with a presence beyond.
related_events: Grace expresses gratitude to God

name: Jack Orders the Broadcast Cut
description: Jack stands with his jaw dropped, then snaps out of it. "Alright, cut the feed! Cut to black if you have to," he says. The control booth operator replies, "I'm on it," and takes action to stop the transmission.
related_events: Jack reacts to shocking event and orders feed to be cut
Control booth operator responds to Jack's command

name: Staffers React to Monitor Display
description: The employees in the office suddenly stop what they are doing. All eyes turn toward a monitor. They stand motionless, staring at the screen, their faces showing shock.
related_events: Work stops across the office
Staffers stare at the monitor in shock

name: Grace Confronts a Disturbing Reality
description: Grace stands frozen, her voice trembling as she repeats, 'This isn't happening,' over and over. Her eyes are wide, fixed on something in front of her. She takes a step back, hands shaking, unable to accept what is unfolding before her.
related_events: Grace expresses disbelief about unfolding events

name: Bruce Confronts Bill About the Anchor Job
description: Bruce walks into view, the camera following him. He calls for Bill and pulls him into the frame despite Bill shaking his head in refusal. Bruce tells Bill he has been running the Maid of the Mist for 23 years, then asks why he didn’t get the anchor job. He runs his hands through his hair, making it messy, and asks if it’s his hair or if his teeth aren’t white enough. He leans toward the camera, inching closer until his face is just an inch away, and speaks about the bedrock of his life slowly eroding. He repeats the word 'eroding' three times, each time stretching the syllables longer—'Erroding. Erroooding. Errodiiiing...'
related_events: Bruce pulls Bill into frame and questions him about a job rejection

name: Bruce Finds Grace's Note While Sam Acts Strangely
description: Bruce stands in the bathroom, looking at a note stuck to the mirror. It reads: 'I LOVE YOU. WE NEED TO TALK. Grace.' An old photograph of Bruce and Grace, smiling together, is taped beside it. He stares at the note, then shifts his gaze downward, noticing Sam circling repeatedly on the rug. Bruce's expression tightens as he watches.
related_events: Bruce discovers note from Grace on bathroom mirror
Bruce observes Sam circling on the rug

name: Bruce Reacts After Being Thrown Out
description: Bruce was thrown out through the front doors, landing hard on the ground as his box of belongings spilled across the pavement. He scrambled to his feet, waving his arms at the building, knocking over a trash can before stooping to gather his scattered items.
related_events: Bruce is thrown out of the building
Bruce flails at the building

name: Bruce Nolan Appears on the Maid of the Mist
description: Bruce Nolan suddenly appears aboard the Maid of the Mist at Niagara Falls, looking alert and energized. He thanks Susan and announces his name, speaking live from the boat as it moves through the mist near the falls.
related_events: Bruce Nolan suddenly appears aboard the Maid of the Mist
Bruce Nolan thanks Susan and announces his presence

name: Jack Awaits Bruce's Response While Feed Is Confirmed
description: The console operator states that the feed is good. Jack calls out to Bruce, urging him to respond. When Bruce does not answer, Jack tells the operator to get ready to pull the plug.
related_events: Console operator reports feed is good
Jack urges Bruce to respond and prepares to terminate connection

name: Bruce Answers the Call
description: Bruce dials a phone number. A prerecorded voice responds, speaking about workplace frustrations, unearned success, and asking if the listener's name is Bruce. The voice gives an address on rd Street. Bruce picks up a pen and writes down the address as the message continues.
related_events: Bruce dials a phone number and hears a prerecorded message
Bruce writes down the address from the automated message

name: Grace Urges the Child to Speak During Tense Moment
description: Grace sits in the room watching TV with a few other teachers. The atmosphere feels heavy. She looks toward a child, her voice soft but insistent. 'Talk honey, talk,' she says, repeating the words as if holding onto them.
related_events: Grace expresses concern while watching TV with other teachers
Grace urges a child to talk

name: Jack Expresses Relief and Leaves the Room
description: Jack lets out a sigh of relief, pats the Director on the shoulder, and then walks out of the room.
related_events: Jack expresses relief and pats the Director's shoulder
Jack leaves the room

name: Bruce Takes Sam Outside and Reacts to His Innocent Look
description: Bruce carries Sam outside and sets him down on the grass. Sam looks up at Bruce, calm and innocent. Bruce watches him and says, 'Oh, you're all done, huh? B-e-a-utiful.'
related_events: Bruce places Sam on the grass outside
Sam looks up at Bruce with innocence
Bruce comments on Sam finishing with sarcastic praise

name: Bruce Reacts to Ally's Signal
description: Bruce stands soaked, gripping the umbrella, his clothes heavy with water. Ally makes a signal to him. Bruce turns his gaze toward the camera and stares, motionless, his face blank.
related_events: Ally signals Bruce that he is on
Bruce stares into the camera in a numb state

name: Susan Reacts to a Technical Alert While Evan Watches
description: Susan hears a message through her ear piece and reacts visibly. She speaks up, reporting that there may be a technical issue. In the background, Evan smiles, clearly entertained by what he sees.
related_events: Susan reacts to a message in her ear piece
Susan reports a technical difficulty
Evan smiles while observing the situation

name: Bruce Licks Camera Lens and Delivers Crude Sign-Off
description: Bruce licks the camera lens while on live broadcast. He steps back, faces the camera, and says, 'I'm Bruce Nolan for Eyewitness News. Back to you fuckers,' before ending the segment.
related_events: Bruce licks the camera lens during news broadcast
Bruce signs off from Eyewitness News broadcast

name: Jack Returns as Bruce Rails Against Injustice
description: Jack bursts back into the room. Bruce, standing nearby, speaks bitterly about the unfairness of life, contrasting the misery of those drenched and freezing on a boat with the undeserved comfort of others in warm newsrooms. In the middle of his outburst, he hurls an umbrella across the room.
related_events: Jack abruptly returns to the room
Bruce expresses cynical reflection on life inequality
Bruce throws an umbrella in frustration

name: Bruce Questions the Old Woman About Titanic
description: Bruce begins by smiling and offering a sarcastic congratulations to Evan Baxter. He then turns to the Old Woman and asks why she threw the blue 'Heart of the Ocean' jewel into the ocean, letting it sink beneath the railing of the Titanic. He follows by asking if she felt any guilt letting Leonardo DiCaprio freeze to death while she stayed dry on the floating door. He wonders aloud whether DiCaprio might have survived if they had shared the door, or if she was simply unwilling to endure the cold herself.
related_events: Bruce sarcastically congratulates Evan Baxter
Bruce questions Old Woman about discarding the Heart of the Ocean
Bruce accuses Old Woman of causing Leonardo DiCaprio's death

name: Jack Responds to Bruce's System Failure
description: Jack rushes into the control room and looks at the monitor displaying Bruce. He asks what is happening. The director responds that they have a Walt Disney. The console operator adds that Bruce is frozen solid. Jack notes that Bruce may have lost audio and tells the team to check his feed. He instructs them to have Susan take over as cover.
related_events: Jack rushes into the control room and questions Bruce's status
Console operator reports Bruce is frozen on system
Jack instructs team to check Bruce's audio feed and assign Susan as cover

name: Bruce Flees the Building and Walks on a Puddle
description: Bruce bursts out of the building and rushes toward his car. As he runs, he steps into a puddle, but instead of sinking, his foot stays on the surface and he walks across it. He stops for a moment, staring down. Then he turns and sprints away.
related_events: Bruce exits building in a hurry
Bruce steps in puddle but walks across without sinking
Bruce pauses momentarily in confusion
Bruce continues running after brief pause

name: Bruce Carries a Peeing Dog and Accidentally Sprinkles a Man on the Stairs
description: Bruce runs forward while holding Sam, who is urinating, out at arm's length. As a man climbs the stairs toward him, Bruce shifts to avoid a collision. In the motion, some of Sam's urine splashes onto the man. Bruce says, "Whoops, sorry."
related_events: Bruce runs while carrying the peeing Sam
Sam urinates while being carried by Bruce
Bruce dodges a man ascending the stairs
Man ascending the stairs gets sprinkled with urine
Bruce apologizes after dodging the man

name: Bruce Arrives and Rights the Trash Can
description: Bruce screeches into a parking space and quickly steps out of his car, knocking over a trash can in the process. He pauses, turns back, and picks the trash can upright before continuing on.
related_events: Bruce races out of the car and bumps over a trash can
Bruce goes back to pick up the trash can

name: Bruce Sees the Homeless Man and Reads the Sign
description: Bruce screeches into a parking space, rushes out of his car, and bumps over a trash can. He stops, turns back, and picks the trash can up. As he does, he notices a homeless man sitting peacefully beside a paint bucket and several sign boards. Bruce looks at the sign currently displayed, which reads: R EWE BLIND? He studies it for a moment, his expression briefly quizzical, then turns and continues on his way.
related_events: Bruce sees a homeless man sitting next to a paint bucket and sign boards
Bruce reads the sign that says 'R EWE BLIND?'

name: Grace Turns Off the Alarm and Kisses Bruce Before Rising
description: Grace reaches over and turns off the alarm. She rolls toward Bruce, snuggling close to him. She kisses him gently, then pulls away, getting out of bed.
related_events: Grace turns off the alarm and snuggles close to Bruce
Grace kisses Bruce and gets out of bed

name: Bruce Clings to Sleep After Grace Leaves
description: Bruce lies in bed with a big smile, telling Grace he’s having a great dream. Grace turns off the alarm, rolls over to kiss him, then gets up. The bed covers are suddenly yanked away. Bruce reacts with an exaggerated, playful tantrum.
related_events: Bruce claims he is having a great dream to avoid waking up
The bed covers are suddenly pulled out of frame
Bruce throws a mock hissy fit after losing the covers

name: Bruce Tries to Start the Car
description: Bruce turns the key in the ignition. The engine turns over but doesn't start, sputtering to a stop. The car sits silent.
related_events: Bruce attempts to start the car but fails initially

name: Bruce Reacts to Car Failure with Frustration and Distress
description: The car turns over but doesn't start. Bruce says he's having a breakdown, calling it a normal, everyday psychotic episode caused by a tumor or brain lesion. He releases the key, the engine winds down, and he pounds the steering wheel in frustration. He shouts at the car to start. The car instantly starts. Bruce says it was lucky, backs up, and peels out.
related_events: Bruce expresses frustration and declares a mental breakdown

name: Bruce Starts the Car and Speeds Away
description: Bruce leans forward, turns the key, and the engine turns over but doesn't catch. He slumps back, then suddenly leans in again, pressing his hands on the steering wheel. 'Come on, start,' he says. The engine roars to life instantly. He shifts into reverse, backs up quickly, and peels out, tires screeching as he speeds away.
related_events: Car starts immediately after Bruce urges it to start
Bruce backs up and accelerates rapidly out of the location

name: Bruce Arrives at the Old Building
description: Bruce drives his demolished car up to an old building on the outskirts of town. He steps out and scans the surrounding area, his eyes moving over the structure with suspicion. The faded sign on the wall reads OMNI PRESENTS. He takes a cautious step forward, then suddenly sinks into a puddle up to his knee. Cursing under his breath, he pulls his leg free, shakes off the muck, and continues toward the entrance.
related_events: Bruce's car enters the frame near an old building
Bruce studies the building and surrounding area suspiciously

name: Bruce Steps into a Hidden Puddle
description: Bruce approaches the old building on the outskirts of town. As he moves across the ground, he steps into a hidden puddle and sinks up to his knee. He pulls his leg free, shakes off the water, and continues toward the entrance.
related_events: Bruce steps in a puddle and sinks up to his knee
Bruce expresses frustration and shakes off his wet leg

name: Bruce Enters the Old Building
description: Bruce stepped carefully past the puddle, shaking off the soaked leg of his pants. He approached the entrance of the old building, pushed the door open, and went inside.
related_events: Bruce heads inside the old building

name: Bruce Stuck in Traffic After Accident
description: Bruce sits in his car amid a line of stopped vehicles, the result of a serious accident ahead. He stares at the prayer beads hanging from his rearview mirror, his expression sour. An injured person is carried past his window on a stretcher by emergency personnel, but Bruce doesn't react. He checks his watch, then mutters under his breath. His beeper sounds. He reads the message, sighs, and abruptly pulls onto the shoulder, swerving around the line of cars. Sirens wail behind him. He pulls over again, steam rising from the engine, and looks up at the sky.
related_events: Emergency personnel transport an injured person on a stretcher
Bruce expresses frustration toward the traffic situation

name: Bruce Takes the Shoulder to Reach a Meeting
description: Bruce checks his beeper as it sounds, seeing a notification that his meeting has started. He looks to the right of the car ahead, then steers onto the shoulder, driving past rows of stopped vehicles. As he speeds forward, he laughs and mutters, 'Catch you later, lemmings,' before a siren sounds and he pulls over, glaring upward.
related_events: Bruce receives a beeper notification about the meeting starting
Bruce decides to bypass traffic by driving on the shoulder

name: Bruce Pulled Over by Police Siren
description: Bruce speeds along the shoulder to bypass stalled traffic, weaving past motionless cars. A police siren blares behind him. He slows, pulls over to the side of the road, and stops. Steam rises from the engine as he sits, staring ahead. He looks up toward the sky and mutters something under his breath.
related_events: Police siren causes Bruce to pull over in frustration

name: Bruce Sets Sam Down and Finds the Beeping Fragment
description: Bruce places Sam on the grass. Sam looks up, face still, as if spent. A beeping sound cuts through the air—BEEP, BEEP, BEEP. Bruce turns and walks toward the source. He crouches by the shattered remains of a beeper, picks up a small piece with an intact LED display. The numbers '772' glow faintly. Bruce stares, his expression shifting to one of amazement.
related_events: Bruce places Sam on the grass
Sam looks up with a finished expression
Bruce walks to the shattered beeper
Bruce picks up fragment of shattered beeper with LED display
Bruce reacts with amazement to the beeper's display

name: Sam Looks Up with a Finished Expression
description: Bruce sets Sam down on the grass. Sam looks up, his expression finished.
related_events: Sam looks up with a finished expression

name: Bruce Throws Beads and Defies God by the Lake
description: Bruce stumbles from the wreckage of his car, clutching a set of prayer beads. He looks at them briefly before breaking into wild laughter. Without hesitation, he hurls the beads into the lake. He stares upward, shouting at the sky, demanding to be struck down, mocking the absence of divine punishment. He yells that God is the one who should be fired, accusing Him of neglect and indifference. As silence follows, a beeper sounds. Bruce checks it, sees the number 772-5623, mutters a sarcastic remark, and walks away toward the ruined car as the beeping sounds again.
related_events: Bruce throws prayer beads into the lake
Bruce challenges God in a fit of rage

name: Bruce Dismisses the Beep and Walks Away
description: After a moment of silence following his outburst, Bruce's beeper sounds, displaying a phone number. He checks it with a cynical chuckle, mutters that he doesn’t know the number and wouldn’t call it if he did, then walks toward his wrecked car. The beeper sounds again as he moves away.
related_events: Bruce's beeper alerts him with a phone number
Bruce walks toward his wrecked car after checking the beeper

name: Alarm Clock Sounds in the Aftermath
description: The beeping continues, sharp and insistent. The camera focuses on an alarm clock, its red digits glowing as the sound pulses through the silence. The close-up reveals the source of the beeping that echoed during Bruce's outburst. The sound stops abruptly, leaving stillness in the room.
related_events: Alarm clock emits continuous beeping sound

name: Debate Over Promo Tone During Morning Meeting
description: The morning meeting is underway at the news station. Jack Keller leads the discussion while Bruce, Evan, Fred, Dallas, and Ally sit around the table. Ally questions the promotional approach for the flu story, suggesting it may be too alarmist. She points out that the promos could instead highlight Pete's retirement during his final week. Evan responds with a sarcastic remark, proposing a dull alternative tagline. Fred chimes in with a joke about sniffles, and Dallas adds a quip about 'the attack of the killer sniffles.' Ally teases Dallas about his tan, which leads to more laughter when Fred claims he looks orange. Jack interrupts, insisting the promos are approved and urging the group to move on. He confirms the flu story will air as planned, cutting short further debate.
related_events: Ally criticizes the promotional tone for the flu story
Evan proposes sarcastic promo alternatives
Fred and Dallas make jokes about the flu segment
Ally reminds Jack to focus promos on Pete's retirement
Jack reasserts approval of promos and pushes to move on
related_occasions: Morning Meeting At The News Station

name: Jack Announces Evan's Story as Lead, Bruce Arrives Late
description: Bruce bursts into the morning meeting late, interrupting the room. Jack looks at his watch but says nothing. Bruce apologizes, blaming traffic, and asks if they’ve already played his promo spots. Jack informs him they’re going with Evan’s story on the sex scandal at the mayor’s office for sweeps instead. Bruce sinks into his chair, visibly deflated. Evan leans forward, smiling, and says, "That's the way the cookie crumbles," drawing laughter from the others. He adds that the newsroom is like a cookie, prompting more chuckles. Bruce, turning to Evan, remarks sarcastically about his perfect posture, asking if he has to shove a stick up there. Jack cuts in, telling them to knock it off, and announces they’re holding Bruce’s story in reserve. He then resumes the meeting, redirecting the team to the day’s assignments.
related_events: Bruce bursts into the meeting room late
Jack announces Evan's sex scandal story will lead for sweeps
Evan mocks Bruce with a cookie metaphor
Bruce sarcastically comments on Evan's posture
Jack reprimands the team and resumes the meeting
related_occasions: Morning Meeting At The News Station

name: Bruce Intervenes in Gang Harassment
description: Bruce sees a group of gang members pushing around a homeless man who holds a sign, breaking his signs and painting over them. He walks over and tells the gang to leave the man alone. The gang turns, looks at Bruce, laughs, and starts to walk away. Bruce helps the man to his feet and calls after the gang, telling them to keep walking. The gang stops, turns back, and charges at Bruce. They tackle him in a dog pile, hitting and kicking him. When they leave, Bruce is on the ground with a bloody lip, lying next to his car. The car's windows are smashed, the paint is scratched, and the word "HERO" is key-scratched into the door. Bruce gets up, gets into the car, and drives away, passing the homeless man sitting on the ground holding a torn sign that reads "LIFE IS. JUST". Bruce says, "Get a clue, buddy."
related_events: Street gang harasses homeless sign holder
Bruce intervenes in gang harassment
Gang members laugh and leave the scene
Bruce helps injured man to his feet
Bruce warns gang as they walk away

name: Bruce Attacked After Defending Homeless Man
description: After the gang walks away, they suddenly stop, turn back, and charge at Bruce. They tackle him in a dog pile, kicking and punching before fleeing the scene. Bruce lies on the ground with a bloody lip. He hears the sounds of glass breaking and metal scratching. Slowly getting up, he sees his car—windows smashed, paint scraped, and the word "HERO" scratched into the door. He gets in, starts the car, and drives away, passing the homeless man sitting on the sidewalk holding a torn sign that reads "LIFE IS. JUST". Bruce mutters, "Get a clue, buddy," as he pulls out of the parking lot.
related_events: Gang attacks Bruce in retaliation
Gang vandalizes Bruce's car
Bruce finds his car damaged and reacts with disillusionment

name: Bruce Drives Past the Beaten Homeless Man and Makes a Sarcastic Remark
description: Bruce gets into his car, starts the engine, and pulls out of the parking lot. As he drives past the homeless man, who sits on the ground battered and holding a broken sign that reads 'LIFE IS. JUST', Bruce mutters, 'Get a clue, buddy,' and continues driving.
related_events: Bruce drives past injured homeless man and delivers sarcastic remark

name: Bruce Wakes and Misidentifies the Beeper
description: Bruce wakes suddenly, slaps at the alarm clock, and reaches for the phone. He pauses, realizing the sound isn't from the phone but from his beeper. He lies in bed, groggy, and looks at the device.
related_events: Bruce wakes up and slaps at the alarm clock
Bruce reaches for the phone and realizes it is the beeper

name: Bruce Destroys the Beeper After Repeated Call
description: Bruce wakes up and slaps at his alarm clock, still groggy. He reaches for his phone but realizes the sound is coming from his beeper. He checks the display and sees the same number—772-5623. He mutters, 'Well, hello again 772-5623, don't hold your breath,' and tosses the beeper onto the bed. He turns and walks toward the bathroom. The beeper sounds again. Bruce stops, turns back, walks to the window, picks up the beeper, and throws it out. It hits a telephone pole and shatters. He turns and continues walking to the bathroom.
related_events: Bruce checks the beeper and sees the same number again
Bruce tosses the beeper on the bed and starts walking to the bathroom

name: Bruce Destroys the Beeper
description: Bruce was on his way to the bathroom when the beeper sounded again. He stopped, turned back, opened the window, grabbed the beeper, and threw it out. It shattered against a telephone pole. He then continued calmly to the bathroom.
related_events: The beeper sounds again while Bruce is en route to the bathroom
Bruce throws the beeper out the window and shatters it against a telephone pole
Bruce calmly continues to the bathroom after destroying the beeper

name: Bruce Mocks God After the Fight
description: Bruce paces the room with an ice pack pressed to his swollen lip. He begins speaking in a mocking tone, imitating God as a careless and cruel figure who toys with human suffering. He jokes about God releasing a tainted monkey after a cure for syphilis is found and punishing a man in Ohio who prays for strength. As he speaks, Sam starts peeing on the rug. Bruce shifts his attention to the dog, shouting that his aim is off. Grace steps in, puts Sam outside, and returns to comfort Bruce, but he continues his rant, rejecting the idea of divine care and expressing deep frustration with his life.
related_events: Bruce paces with an ice pack on his swollen lip
Bruce mocks God in a sarcastic monologue

name: Grace Removes Sam and Tries to Calm Bruce
description: Sam urinates on the rug. Bruce, standing nearby, reacts with sharp sarcasm, calling out the dog's poor aim. Grace immediately steps in, opens the door, and puts Sam outside. She returns and approaches Bruce, speaking in a soothing tone, trying to comfort him as he paces and clutches the ice pack to his swollen lip.
related_events: Sam urinates on the rug
Bruce sarcastically addresses Sam's poor aim
Grace puts Sam outside to manage the situation
Grace attempts to calm Bruce after removing Sam

name: Bruce Storms Out After Argument with Grace
description: Bruce paces with an ice pack on his swollen lip, speaking bitterly about God and the state of the world. Grace tries to comfort him, saying she’s just glad he’s okay, but Bruce snaps, rejecting her reassurance. He shouts that he’s not okay and rails against his job, their apartment, and his life, calling it all mediocre. In a sudden burst of anger, he sweeps the photos and photo albums off the table onto the floor. Grace, hurt, tells him she’s sorry for being part of his mediocre life. Bruce scoffs, then grows more agitated when she begins to cry. He mutters about guilt and storms toward the door, grabbing his keys. Without another word, he leaves the apartment, slamming the door behind him.
related_events: Bruce expresses anger about his life during argument with Grace
Bruce knocks photos and photo albums off the table
Grace cries in response to Bruce's outburst
Bruce leaves the apartment after argument

name: Bruce Drives in the Rain and Calls Out for a Sign
description: Bruce drives through the rain, the windshield wipers sweeping back and forth. He speaks aloud, asking God to answer, to send a sign. A yellow caution light blinks ahead, but he doesn't slow. A pedestrian steps into the crosswalk and immediately jumps back, shouting, 'Slow down, asshole!' Bruce doesn't react, his eyes fixed on the road, still waiting for an answer.
related_events: Bruce drives aimlessly during a rainstorm
Bruce pleads with God for guidance
Bruce fails to notice a blinking yellow caution light
Pedestrian yells at Bruce to slow down

name: Bruce Sees Signs but Finds No Answer
description: A truck transporting road signs pulls in front of Bruce’s car. The signs display various messages: Yield, Wrong Way, Dead End, Do Not Enter, Stop. The lights on the truck blink in different directions. Bruce looks at them, then sighs and says, 'Oh well, I guess you don't care.'
related_events: Truck carrying road signs pulls in front of Bruce
Bruce interprets lack of response as divine indifference

name: Bruce Searches for the Prayer Beads Before Crashing
description: Bruce sees the prayer beads hanging from the rearview mirror and pulls them down, speaking to God. He asks for a miracle as he holds them. The car hits a bump, and the beads fall to the floor. Bruce reaches down, searching for them, then finds them and lifts them up. In that moment, the car veers and slams into a light post.
related_events: Bruce spots prayer beads on the rearview mirror and speaks to God
Prayer beads fall to the floor after hitting a bump
Bruce searches for and retrieves the prayer beads
Bruce's car crashes into a light post

name: God Releases the Cockroach
description: God leans down and lets the soup-covered cockroach go. As it scurries away, God watches with interest, remarking on how most people would want to kill it, but he finds it fascinating. He describes the cockroach as a creature with a streamlined design, like a tiny armored tank, able to hold its breath for forty minutes and possessing a unique cell structure. Noticing Bruce's blank expression, God pauses and admits the explanation might be too complex for him.
related_events: God releases the cockroach into the wild
God compares cockroach biology to armored tanks

name: God Explains the Rules to Bruce
description: God and Bruce walk along the shore of a lake. Bruce looks at his hands, unsettled by the extra fingers. God notices and laughs, saying the extra fingers were meant to get his attention, just as they did with Gandhi. As they continue walking, God begins to explain the conditions of Bruce's new power. He says Bruce can do anything he wants, but there are two rules: he cannot tell anyone he is God, and he cannot interfere with free will. Bruce asks why, and God seems pleased by the question, about to answer when a large sailboat passes close by. Bruce turns to look, and only then realizes they are walking on the surface of the lake. He stares in awe. God reaches into the water and pulls out a set of prayer beads, tucking them into his pocket. He says he’ll be seeing Bruce later. Bruce asks where he is going. God replies that he’s taking a vacation. Bruce hesitates, then begins carefully stepping toward the shore, eventually breaking into a full sprint.
related_events: Bruce expresses confusion about his extra fingers
God explains divine rules to Bruce

name: God and Bruce Walk on the Lake
description: God and Bruce walk side by side across the surface of the lake, far from the shore. A large sailboat passes close by, its sail visible as it glides past them. Bruce looks on in awe, watching the boat move through the water while he remains standing on the lake’s surface. God reaches down, dips his hand into the water, and pulls out a set of prayer beads, which he places in his pocket. He continues walking, then begins to move away from Bruce, leaving him alone on the water.
related_events: God and Bruce walk on the lake surface near the shore

name: God Retrieves the Prayer Beads and Takes His Leave
description: God dips his hand into the lake and pulls out the prayer beads, then slips them into his pocket. He tells Bruce he is going on vacation. Bruce asks if God can really take a vacation. God replies with a question about the Dark Ages, then says he’s covered because Bruce can fix everything in five minutes if he wants to. With that, God begins to walk away across the lake.
related_events: God retrieves the prayer beads from the lake
God announces he is going on vacation

name: Bruce Returns to Shore
description: After God walks away, Bruce is left standing on the surface of the lake. He starts moving carefully toward the shore, placing one foot in front of the other with hesitation. As he progresses, his steps grow faster, and soon he is sprinting across the water until he reaches the land.
related_events: Bruce begins walking back to shore after God departs

name: Bruce Prepares for Live Segment at Niagara Falls
description: Ally leads Bruce to the bow of the boat and hands him a blue umbrella shaped like a waterfall, emblazoned with the Maid of the Mist insignia. Bruce mutters sarcastically about wearing his tap shoes, eyeing the umbrella with disdain. Ally reminds him they need the segment for the exclusive coverage, then positions a very elderly woman, Irene Dansfeild, beside him. She explains that Irene rode on the maiden voyage with her late husband. Ally counts down—ninety seconds until airtime. Bruce looks up at the ridiculous umbrella, takes a breath, and quietly tells himself to stay composed, to think like an anchor, to ignore the umbrella and just get through it.
related_events: Ally directs Bruce to the bow of the boat for a segment
Bruce receives a branded umbrella from Ally
Bruce expresses skepticism about the umbrella and the assignment
Ally provides Bruce with background details about the occasion
Ally introduces Irene Dansfeild to Bruce for an interview
Bruce mentally prepares for the live broadcast
related_occasions: Maid Of The Mist 23Rd Anniversary Tour

name: Susan Announces Pete's Retirement and Evan's Promotion on Live TV
description: During the live broadcast, Susan Ortega announces that Pete Fineman is retiring after 33 years. Pete smiles proudly as the news is met with applause. Susan then introduces Evan Baxter as Pete's replacement. Evan thanks the team, expresses his pride in being part of the Buffalo community, and shares a lighthearted remark about what makes a great city, prompting laughter from the anchors. Susan praises his words, then transitions to Bruce Nolan at Niagara Falls.
related_events: Susan Ortega announces Pete Fineman's retirement on air
Susan Ortega introduces Evan Baxter as Pete Fineman's replacement
Evan Baxter delivers a congratulatory speech upon his promotion
related_occasions: Live Television Broadcast Announcement At Niagara Falls

name: Bruce Hears Evan's Promotion Announcement
description: Bruce stands on the bow of the Maid of the Mist boat, holding a blue umbrella shaped like Niagara Falls. He listens through his earpiece as the broadcast begins. Pete Fineman delivers a report on a chemical spill, then Susan Ortega announces Pete's retirement. She introduces Evan Baxter as the new anchor. Evan speaks, expressing pride in the community and sharing a lighthearted comment about Buffalo being like a recipe. The newsroom crew chuckles. Bruce's face goes pale. Ahead, a man in a red pit crew suit stands in the road, waving a red flag. Bruce swerves violently to avoid him, then screeches to a halt as the car pulls into a makeshift pit stop. A group of Italian men in red racing uniforms surrounds the vehicle, jacking it up, replacing the tires with large mag wheels, and refueling it. Paul Newman appears at the driver’s window, asking in English if Bruce received the box of dressing he sent. Bruce responds in fluent Italian, saying yes and inviting him to dinner. The crew gestures for Bruce to go, urging him in Italian. The car lurches forward on its own, speeding away. Bruce fights the wheel before managing to pull over. The doors won’t open, so he climbs out through the driver’s window, stumbling onto the sidewalk. He backs away from the car, a normal-looking Taurus, then quickly enters a nearby diner.

Bruce, frustrated, complained about his hair and questioned why no makeup artist was available. Ally Loman, the segment producer, approached and handed him a hair net, explaining it was required by health code for being near the cookie and in the kitchen area. Ally counted down for the live shot, and Bruce instantly transformed into his polished news persona, delivering a smooth report about the bakery’s history, the record-breaking cookie, and the family’s celebration, ending with a toast and a dramatic sign-off. name: Bruce Orders Coffee at the Diner
description: Bruce enters the diner and walks quickly to a back corner booth. He sits down and mutters to himself, repeating, 'It isn't real, it isn't real, it isn't real.' The waitress, a Sally Kirkland-type woman with an order pad in hand, stands nearby, watching him with a raised eyebrow. Bruce looks up and says, 'Oh hi, ah, coffee please.' The waitress pours him a cup of coffee without responding.

name: Waitress Confesses Secrets to Bruce
description: The waitress sets the soup down in front of Bruce and begins to walk away. She stops, turns back, and looks at him with a troubled expression. Her voice trembles as she tells him she lies to her sister and is sleeping with her best friend's husband. She admits she knows he's using her, but says she's tired of being alone. She doesn't know why she's telling him all this, only that he seems like he might understand. Bruce sits quietly and says, 'Okay.' name: Bruce Parts the Soup
description: Bruce looks at the soup in front of him, his expression growing intense. He slowly raises his hands over the bowl. A wind sweeps through the diner, rattling the windows and sending napkins fluttering to the floor. The red liquid in the bowl begins to split apart, forming a clear path down the middle as dramatic music swells. A small cockroach scurries across the table, climbs the edge of the bowl, and walks through the parted soup. The moment breaks as the liquid collapses back into the bowl, splashing down on the insect. The wind dies down, and the music fades.

name: God Appears and Calls Bruce to Walk
description: Bruce sits in the diner booth, his hands raised over the soup bowl as the red liquid parts. A gust of wind sweeps through the diner, and a voice from nowhere asks, 'Havin' fun?' Startled, Bruce flinches, and the soup collapses back into the bowl, splashing down on a cockroach that had crawled across. He looks up to see God now standing beside his booth. Without another word, God says, 'Let's take a walk.'

name: Bruce Checks the Building Directory
description: Bruce enters the building and looks at the BUILDING DIRECTORY, which lists several rooms: OMNI PRESENTS UNLTD., Personnel Rm., Accounting Rm., Security Rm., and Creative Rm. A voice from off-screen says, 'You're looking for room 7.' Bruce turns to see a JANITOR mopping the floor. The janitor notices Bruce's wet leg and offers him the mop. Bruce forces a smile and asks how to get to room 7. The janitor tells him it's on the seventh floor and points to the stairs. Bruce asks about the elevator, and the janitor indicates it is out of order. Bruce starts toward the stairs.

name: Bruce Meets the Janitor-Electrician on the Seventh Floor
description: Bruce climbs the stairs to the seventh floor and pushes open the door to a large, empty room. At the far end, a single desk sits beneath a high ceiling. Bruce hears the sound of someone working above and calls out. A voice tells him to wait, then a bright white light suddenly flashes on, blinding him. He shields his eyes as the light floods the room. An electrician descends from a ladder that extends into a hole in the ceiling. As he steps down, Bruce sees that he is the same man who was mopping the floor earlier—the janitor. The janitor unzips his uniform to reveal a suit underneath and walks over to the desk.

name: Janitor Reveals Himself as the Boss
description: The janitor claps his hands twice, and the bright overhead light shuts off. He begins to sing, 'CLAP ON. CLAP OFF. CLAP ON, CLAP OFF. THE CLAPPER,' then laughs and claps again. He unzips his janitor's uniform to reveal a well-tailored suit underneath, steps forward, and extends his hand to Bruce. 'You must be Bruce. I've been expecting you.'

name: Janitor Reveals File on Bruce and Mentions His Father
description: The janitor unzips his uniform to reveal a suit underneath and tells Bruce he has been expecting him. He says he knows everything Bruce has ever said, done, or thought about doing, and gestures to a file cabinet with a single drawer. Bruce pulls the drawer open, and it suddenly flies open on its own, dragging him across the room. The janitor casually takes a file from the cabinet, then slams his fist on it, causing the drawer to snap shut, yanking Bruce back toward the desk. The janitor taps the file and says the most recent entry was disturbing. He mentions that Bruce’s father was a good welder and speaks about the value of manual labor, saying people underestimate it and that the happiest ones work until they stink at the end of the day.

name: The Janitor Reveals Himself as God and Demonstrates His Power
description: The janitor sits behind the desk and opens a file, reading from it as Bruce watches. He tells Bruce that the last entry is disturbing. Bruce tries to pull out the drawer to look through the file himself, but the drawer suddenly flies open, yanking him across the room. The janitor slams his fist into the cabinet and the drawer snaps shut, dragging Bruce back toward the desk. The janitor says, 'I'm God,' and Bruce scoffs. Bruce turns to leave, but stumbles, disoriented. He accuses the janitor of staging a hidden camera show. He examines the file cabinet, trying to figure out the trick. The janitor asks how many fingers he is holding up. Bruce says five. The janitor asks again, and Bruce still sees five. The janitor changes the number, and Bruce counts again—this time he sees seven fingers on one hand. He blinks, confused, unable to explain what he just saw.
